verdict.rationale: Firebase ships AI features such as Gemini in Firebase and Firebase AI Logic, so it is fair to ask whether it can consume external MCP servers. The evidence only documents the Firebase MCP server, which serves Firebase tools to outside clients like Claude Code and Cursor. That is the server role, a different story, so it earns no credit here, and nothing shows Firebase acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
